'''Chapter 1015''' is titled "Chains".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page]] Request: "[[Senor Pink]] being confused for a baby by a stork" by PN Toshikiya.

==Short Summary==
[[Queen]] and [[Charlotte Perospero]] are on the verge of overwhelming [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] and the alliance fighters on the Live Floor, but [[Sanji]] then arrives and attacks Queen, causing the All-Star's long [[Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Brachiosaurus|brachiosaurus]] neck to spin around and strike Perospero.

Meanwhile, as [[Kaidou]] finishes off [[Kin'emon]] by piercing through his chest, [[Momonosuke]] realizes the voice inside his head is from [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]. As he and Shinobu flee from Kaidou, Momonosuke finds a frog [[Beasts Pirates#Marys|Mary]] and uses it to broadcast Luffy's message to him: that he is alive, and will return to the battle. The alliance fighters rejoice and renew their confidence, and Luffy is found underwater by the [[Heart Pirates]] in the [[Polar Tang]]. Kaidou chases Momonosuke and Shinobu to the edge of Onigashima, and Shinobu uses [[Juku Juku no Mi|her ability]] to break off the ground they are standing on. Kaidou is then confronted by [[Yamato]], who calls him by his name and expresses the intention to break off their bond.

==Long Summary==
The samurai and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] cry in sadness and fear over the possibility that [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] is dead, with several of them wondering if they should keep fighting and if [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] is safe. [[Briscola]], who despite having consumed [[Tama]]'s [[Kibi Kibi no Mi|kibi dango]], was still fighting against the samurai due to having not been given an order yet, and says that it isn't that the enemies are weak, it's just that [[Kaidou]] is too strong.

[[Izou]] and [[Kawamatsu]] know that the message was to hurt everyone's morale but [[Sanji]] becomes annoyed at how several are losing their will to fight. As for [[Queen]], he defeats Chopper and tells him he was just playing with him since Chopper seemed so sure he could beat him. Also, Perospero fires a '''Candy Shower''' of candy arrows, causing the samurai to run in fear and take cover. Queen then reveals his teeth to have retractable spikes and calls Chopper a coward as he prepares to kill him, but Sanji comes to the rescue and attacks Queen with '''[[Black Leg Style/Diable Jambe#After the Timeskip|Diable Jambe: Rotisserie Strike]]''', smacking him around while also deflecting Perospero's candy arrows, while he also knocks Queen into Perospero and knocking him away.

Sanji commends Chopper for how long he stood his ground as Chopper tries to tell him about Luffy. Sanji, however, scolds him for crying and reminds him of all the miracles Luffy has pulled off in situations like these. He hands the bandaged [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] off to him commenting he is worth at least ten men (which Zoro retorts that he is worth two thousand) as he says he will handle Queen as he identifies Sanji as [[Vinsmoke Judge|Judge]]'s son. The samurai are in disbelief as to how the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] are still fighting despite the announcement that their captain is supposedly dead, and [[Polo Marco|Marco]] reveals this is why he likes them.

Up on the First Floor, [[Shinobu]] runs away with Momonosuke as a heavily injured [[Kin'emon]] tries to stab Kaidou with his broken sword. He thinks back to when he told Momonosuke to call him father to hide his connection to [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]] and how they eventually succeeded in pulling off the illusion. As for Kaidou, he asks Kin'emon what the point is in buying time and running as he stabs him through the back with a sword. He tells him that it isn't easy to accept defeat, but he should embrace his honorable death as a samurai.

As Shinobu runs carrying Momonosuke, she sees that he had picked up a frog Mary, where he announces to his allies that Luffy wanted him to tell them that Luffy is still alive and that he would make it back, so no matter how hurt everyone is or if they have nothing left, they have to keep fighting, as it turns out the voice he previously heard was Luffy unconsciously telling him that he will defeat Kaidou.

Momonosuke's words reinvigorate his allies as Kaidou finally corners him and Shinobu. Shinobu uses her [[Juku Juku no Mi|Devil Fruit powers]] to rot the rocks and causes the two of them to fall, much to his displeasure. As for Luffy, he is found by the [[Heart Pirates]] who proceed to save him. [[Kurozumi Tama|Tama]] cries in happiness that Luffy is alive and she, [[Usopp]], and [[Nami]] run to the main stage, but Nami hears a voice coming from her Sorcery Clima-Tact, looking down to see what appears to be [[Zeus]]' face.

[[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] says that Momonosuke was bluffing, and the war ended the minute he fell into the sea, but [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]] arrives on the scene and says that since he has been working with him for so long, he has now learned to never give up faith with him. [[Eustass Kid|Kid]] asks Law if he is getting in his way, and Law tells Kid that they should play nice for now and work together.

[[Yamato]] finally catches up to Kaidou and addresses him by name, causing him to tell Yamato to call him "father". Yamato, however, declares that he has come to free himself from this so-called "parental bond".

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*News of [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]'s defeat has begun to affect the morale of the [[Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance|alliance]].
*[[Sanji]]'s group arrives at the Live Stage.
**[[Queen]] reveals that he had only been playing with [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]], as he and [[Charlotte Perospero|Perospero]] prepare to finish him off.
**Sanji attacks Queen to save Chopper. The attack also deflects Perospero's latest attack and knocks him away.
**Sanji hands off [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] to Chopper and prepares to fight Queen.
*[[Kin'emon]] survived [[Kaidou]]'s attack, but is heavily wounded.
**Kaidou pierces Kin'emon with a sword.
*[[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] confirms that Luffy is still alive, having sensed him earlier, and uses the frog Mary to broadcast this news across [[Onigashima]], restoring the alliance's morale.
**[[Shinobu]] and Momonosuke are cornered by Kaidou, but Shinobu uses her [[Juku Juku no Mi|ability]] to escape the [[Skull Dome]].
*Luffy is found by the [[Heart Pirates]] in their [[Polar Tang|submarine]].
**The Heart Pirates note that Luffy was able to communicate with them from underwater somehow.
*[[Nami]]'s [[Art of Weather/Sorcery Clima-Tact|Clima-Tact]] is shown to have slightly transformed and now [[Homies|has a face]] similar to [[Zeus]]' that can talk.
*[[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]] joins [[Eustass Kid|Kid]] in the latter's fight against [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]].
*While Kaidou is outside, [[Yamato]] calls out to him from the roof.

==Trivia==
*The title of the chapter uses the kanji 縁, which can mean "bond" or "relationship" between two people. However, the furigana gives the non-standard reading くさり (''kusari''), which is derived from the Japanese word for "chain". Thus, the title refers to the relationship between Kaidou and Yamato, which Yamato likens to "chains".
